name: farm.js
description: A modern React meta-framework that human and ai could understand

scripts.test:e2e:production: corepack pnpm --filter @farm.js/core build && corepack pnpm --filter @farm.js/cli build && corepack pnpm test:e2e:production:run
scripts.test:e2e:production:sites: corepack pnpm --filter @farm.js/core build && corepack pnpm --filter @farm.js/cli build && corepack pnpm test:e2e:production:sites:run
scripts.test:e2e:production:sites:run: corepack pnpm --dir docs run prisma:generate && FARM_VITE_BUILDER=rolldown corepack pnpm --dir docs exec farm build --preset node-server && FARM_VITE_BUILDER=rolldown corepack pnpm --dir examples/ssr-ssg-demo exec farm build --preset node-server && playwright test --config playwright.production-sites.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:framework: corepack pnpm --filter @farm.js/core build && corepack pnpm --filter @farm.js/cli build && corepack pnpm --filter @farm.js/plugin build && corepack pnpm test:e2e && corepack pnpm test:e2e:production:run && corepack pnpm test:e2e:production:sites:run && corepack pnpm test:e2e:i18n:run && corepack pnpm test:e2e:rsc:run
scripts.test:e2e:i18n: corepack pnpm --filter @farm.js/core build && corepack pnpm --filter @farm.js/cli build && corepack pnpm test:e2e:i18n:run
scripts.test:e2e:i18n:run: corepack pnpm --filter farm-i18n-example build && playwright test --config playwright.i18n.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:rsc: corepack pnpm --filter @farm.js/core build && corepack pnpm --filter @farm.js/plugin build && corepack pnpm test:e2e:rsc:run
scripts.test:e2e:rsc:run: FARM_SKIP_NPM_INSTALL=1 NITRO_PRESET=node-server corepack pnpm --filter farm-rsc-demo build && playwright test --config playwright.rsc.config.ts
scripts.release:beta:farm: turbo --filter "./packages/*" build && pnpm publish -r --filter "./packages/*" --access public --tag beta --no-git-checks
scripts.release:beta: turbo --filter "./packages/*" build && bumpp "packages/*/package.json" && pnpm -r --filter ./packages/* publish --access public --tag beta --no-git-checks
scripts.release:canary: turbo --filter "./packages/*" build && bumpp && pnpm -r publish --access public --tag canary --no-git-checks
